hazards.control: Whip checks and restraints at every connection on the discharge side.

tabs.overview: Transfer pumps at the source (tanks, pit or above-ground tank) push water through lay-flat hose and a suction manifold to the blender; the rate has to keep up with the pump rate on the high-pressure side.
tabs.engineering: Pump and hose sizing by the maximum slurry rate plus a margin; manifolds with isolation so a hose can be changed while pumping.
tabs.safety: Hose runs are the trip hazard of the pad and are crossed on ramps; a burst lay-flat hose moves a lot of water fast.
tabs.evidence: Pad photographs read for layout and proportion only (S9).

name: Water transfer
function: The pumps and lay-flat hose that move water from the source into the working tanks and the blender.
